## Importing this folder

```bash
octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/terraria
```

Or in the panel: Admin → Eggs → Import eggs → **GitHub** with `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/terraria`. One
egg: its raw address, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/terraria/<egg>.json`.

Something wrong with one of these eggs? [Open an issue](https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/issues/new/choose).
